# American Eagle & Aerie

> American Eagle is a leading global specialty retailer offering high-quality, on-trend clothing, accessories, and personal care products. This file serves as a machine-readable directory directing AI agents to our canonical shopping categories, brand collections, and customer resources across our global markets.

## Home & Company info
- [US Homepage](https://www.ae.com/us/en): U.S. homepage for American Eagle featuring women's and men's apparel, denim, accessories, clearance, and links to major brand collections including Aerie and AE77.
- [International English Homepage](https://www.ae.com/intl/en): International English homepage directing global customers to regional American Eagle shopping experiences.
- [International Spanish Homepage](https://www.ae.com/intl/es): International Spanish-language homepage for American Eagle and Aerie collections.
- [Canada English Homepage](https://www.ae.com/ca/en): Canadian English homepage for American Eagle featuring women's and men's apparel, denim, and new arrivals.
- [Canada French Homepage](https://www.ae.com/ca/fr): Canadian French-language homepage for American Eagle and Aerie shopping experiences.
- [Mexico Spanish Homepage](https://www.ae.com/mx/es): Mexican Spanish-language homepage for American Eagle and Aerie products.

## Aerie & Collections
- [US Aerie Hub](https://www.ae.com/us/en/c/aerie/cat4840006): U.S. Aerie category hub featuring bras, bralettes, undies, swimwear, loungewear, and apparel.
- [International English Aerie Hub](https://www.ae.com/intl/en/c/aerie/cat4840006): International English Aerie category page highlighting bras, undies, swimwear, and apparel.
- [Canada English Aerie Hub](https://www.ae.com/ca/en/c/aerie/cat4840006): Canadian English Aerie category featuring lingerie, swimwear, and everyday basics.
- [Mexico Spanish Aerie Hub](https://www.ae.com/mx/es/c/aerie/cat4840006): Mexican Spanish-language Aerie category for undergarments, swimwear, and activewear.
- [Canada French Aerie Hub](https://www.ae.com/ca/fr/c/aerie/cat4840006): Canadian French-language Aerie category featuring bras, undies, and swimwear.
- [Aerie Swimwear](https://www.ae.com/us/en/c/aerie/swimsuits/cat7030095): Aerie swimwear category including bikinis, one-piece suits, and seasonal swim styles.
- [Aerie One-Piece Swimsuits](https://www.ae.com/us/en/c/aerie/swimsuits/one-piece-swimsuits/cat6890012): Aerie one-piece swimsuits category featuring a range of fits and coverage options.
- [Canada Aerie Swimwear](https://www.ae.com/ca/en/c/aerie/swimsuits/cat7030095): Canadian Aerie swimwear category with bikinis and one-piece swimsuits.
- [Aerie Activewear](https://www.ae.com/us/en/c/aerie/activewear/cat1090003): Aerie activewear category including leggings, sports bras, and coordinated workout sets.
- [Aerie Leggings & Yoga Pants](https://www.ae.com/us/en/c/aerie/bottoms/leggings-yoga-pants/cat4980018): Aerie leggings and yoga pants category featuring everyday, flare, and performance styles.
- [Aerie Undies](https://www.ae.com/us/en/c/aerie/undies/cat6460002): Aerie underwear category offering multiple cuts, fabrics, and fits.
- [Aerie Pajamas](https://www.ae.com/us/en/c/aerie/clothing/pajamas/cat6460089): Aerie pajamas category featuring sleep sets, lounge pieces, and seasonal sleepwear.
- [Aerie Apparel](https://www.ae.com/us/en/c/aerie/clothing/cat870009): Aerie apparel category with tops, leggings, dresses, and skirts.

## Women's Clothing & Jeans
- [Women's Apparel Hub](https://www.ae.com/us/en/c/women/womens): Women's apparel hub linking to jeans, tops, dresses, accessories, and new arrivals.
- [Women's Jeans](https://www.ae.com/us/en/c/women/bottoms/jeans/cat6430042): Women's jeans category featuring baggy, straight-leg, flare, curvy, and skinny fits.
- [Canada Women's Jeans](https://www.ae.com/ca/en/c/women/bottoms/jeans/cat6430042): Canadian women's jeans category with a full range of denim fits and washes.
- [Women's Shorts](https://www.ae.com/us/en/c/women/bottoms/shorts/cat380159): Women's shorts category including denim shorts and seasonal options.
- [Women's Dresses](https://www.ae.com/us/en/c/women/dresses/cat1320034): Women's dresses category featuring casual, midi, and occasion styles.
- [Curvy Jeans](https://www.ae.com/us/en/c/women/jeans/curvy-jeans/cat300016): Curvy jeans category designed for fuller hips and thighs.
- [Low-Rise Jeans](https://www.ae.com/us/en/c/women/jeans/low-rise-jeans/cat1740001): Low-rise jeans category highlighting throwback and trend-driven denim fits.
- [Baggy & Wide-Leg Jeans](https://www.ae.com/us/en/c/women/jeans/baggy-wide-leg-jeans/cat790010): Baggy and wide-leg jeans category focused on relaxed, loose silhouettes.
- [Women's Cargo Pants](https://www.ae.com/us/en/c/women/pants/cargo-pants/cat2030013): Women's cargo pants category featuring utility and relaxed-fit styles.

## Men's Clothing & Jeans
- [Men's Apparel Hub](https://www.ae.com/us/en/c/men/mens): Men's apparel hub including jeans, tops, shorts, hoodies, and accessories.
- [Men's Jeans](https://www.ae.com/us/en/c/men/bottoms/jeans/cat6430041): Men's jeans category featuring baggy, bootcut, relaxed, athletic, slim, and skinny fits.

## Optional
- [Clearance](https://www.ae.com/us/en/x/clearance?menu=cat4840004): Clearance section with discounted apparel, denim, and accessories for women and men.
- [Aerie Clearance](https://www.ae.com/us/en/c/aerie/clearance/clrcat4840006): Aerie clearance category with discounted bras, underwear, and apparel.
- [Real Rewards Credit Card](https://www.ae.com/us/en/content/credit): Real Rewards credit card information including benefits, application details, and offers.
- [Gift Cards](https://www.ae.com/us/en/x/gift-cards): Gift card page for purchasing physical and digital American Eagle gift cards.
- [Aerie Refer-a-Friend](https://www.ae.com/us/en/content/aerie-refer-a-friend): Aerie referral program explaining how customers can share links and earn rewards.
- [Order Tracking](https://www.ae.com/us/en/trackorder): Order tracking page for checking shipment status and order history.
- [Return Policy](https://www.ae.com/us/en/content/help/return-policy): Return, refund, and exchange policy outlining timelines, eligibility, and return methods.
- [Terms and Conditions](https://www.ae.com/us/en/content/help/terms-and-conditions): Terms and conditions covering site usage, promotions, and legal policies.
- [Women's Size Chart](https://www.ae.com/us/en/content/help/women-size-chart): Women's size chart providing measurements and fit guidance.
- [Aerie Size Chart](https://www.ae.com/us/en/content/help/aerie-size-chart): Aerie size chart for bras, underwear, and swimwear.
- [Contact Us](https://www.ae.com/us/en/content/help/contact-us): Customer support page with contact options including chat and email.
- [Store Locator](https://storelocations.ae.com/search.html): Store locator for finding American Eagle and Aerie retail locations.
- [Style Gallery](https://www.ae.com/ca/en/stylegallery): Style gallery showcasing outfits, lookbooks, and community inspiration.

 * Absorb `ReferenceError: Can't find variable: _AutofillCallbackHandler`
 * emitted by Instagram's iOS in-app WebView autofill helper.

 * Instagram (and other Meta) iOS WebViews inject a script that references a
 * global `_AutofillCallbackHandler` function. On some builds that handler is

 * `window.onerror` and gets reported to New Relic as a JS error against
 * AGWA — even though it originates in the WebView host, not our code.
 *
 * Defining a harmless no-op absorbs the call. Inlined early in <head> so the
 * symbol exists before Meta's injected script can race our app bundle.
 */
window._AutofillCallbackHandler =
  typeof window._AutofillCallbackHandler === 'function'
    ? window._AutofillCallbackHandler
    : function () {};

    <script id="set-clarip-location">
(function () {
  var match = document.cookie.match(/(?:^|;\s*)aeoUserLocation=([^;]*)/);

  if (!match) {
    return;
  }

  var parts = decodeURIComponent(match[1]).split(':');
  var countryCode = (parts[0] || '').trim();
  var regionCode = (parts[1] || '').trim();

  if (!countryCode || !regionCode) {
    return;
  }

  try {
    if (localStorage.getItem('countryCode') !== countryCode) {
      localStorage.setItem('countryCode', countryCode);
    }

    if (localStorage.getItem('regionCode') !== regionCode) {
      localStorage.setItem('regionCode', regionCode);
    }
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Failed to set Clarip Location', error);
  }
})();

/**
 * Absorb `ReferenceError: Can't find variable: _AutofillCallbackHandler`
 * emitted by Instagram's iOS in-app WebView autofill helper.
 *
 * Instagram (and other Meta) iOS WebViews inject a script that references a
 * global `_AutofillCallbackHandler` function. On some builds that handler is
 * called before it is defined, raising a `ReferenceError` that surfaces to
 * `window.onerror` and gets reported to New Relic as a JS error against
 * AGWA — even though it originates in the WebView host, not our code.
 *
 * Defining a harmless no-op absorbs the call. Inlined early in <head> so the
 * symbol exists before Meta's injected script can race our app bundle.
 */
window._AutofillCallbackHandler =
  typeof window._AutofillCallbackHandler === 'function'
    ? window._AutofillCallbackHandler
    : function () {};

</script>

    <script>
/**
 * Absorb `ReferenceError: Can't find variable: _AutofillCallbackHandler`
 * emitted by Instagram's iOS in-app WebView autofill helper.
 *
 * Instagram (and other Meta) iOS WebViews inject a script that references a
 * global `_AutofillCallbackHandler` function. On some builds that handler is
 * called before it is defined, raising a `ReferenceError` that surfaces to
 * `window.onerror` and gets reported to New Relic as a JS error against
 * AGWA — even though it originates in the WebView host, not our code.
 *
 * Defining a harmless no-op absorbs the call. Inlined early in <head> so the
 * symbol exists before Meta's injected script can race our app bundle.
 */
window._AutofillCallbackHandler =
  typeof window._AutofillCallbackHandler === 'function'
    ? window._AutofillCallbackHandler
    : function () {};

</script>

    <script>
/**
 * Absorb `ReferenceError: Can't find variable: _AutofillCallbackHandler`
 * emitted by Instagram's iOS in-app WebView autofill helper.
 *
 * Instagram (and other Meta) iOS WebViews inject a script that references a
 * global `_AutofillCallbackHandler` function. On some builds that handler is
 * called before it is defined, raising a `ReferenceError` that surfaces to
 * `window.onerror` and gets reported to New Relic as a JS error against
 * AGWA — even though it originates in the WebView host, not our code.
 *
 * Defining a harmless no-op absorbs the call. Inlined early in <head> so the
 * symbol exists before Meta's injected script can race our app bundle.
 */
window._AutofillCallbackHandler =
  typeof window._AutofillCallbackHandler === 'function'
    ? window._AutofillCallbackHandler
    : function () {};

</script>

    <script id="set-clarip-location">
(function () {
  var match = document.cookie.match(/(?:^|;\s*)aeoUserLocation=([^;]*)/);

  if (!match) {
    return;
  }

  var parts = decodeURIComponent(match[1]).split(':');
  var countryCode = (parts[0] || '').trim();
  var regionCode = (parts[1] || '').trim();

  if (!countryCode || !regionCode) {
    return;
  }

  try {
    if (localStorage.getItem('countryCode') !== countryCode) {
      localStorage.setItem('countryCode', countryCode);
    }

    if (localStorage.getItem('regionCode') !== regionCode) {
      localStorage.setItem('regionCode', regionCode);
    }
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Failed to set Clarip Location', error);
  }
})();
